description: Portable canvas record for recreation through Onlook's canvas tools. This is not a native Onlook import format.
restoreInstructions: Open this repository in the destination Onlook instance and start the app using that instance's project setup.
Read this manifest and list the destination canvas pages and frames before making changes.
Create new canvas pages in the recorded order; do not delete or overwrite existing pages. Map each manifest page key to its newly created page ID.
For each frame, create a browser frame on its mapped page using name, x, y, and the running app's base URL plus path. Resize it to width and height with move_frame. Create frames in stack order.
The path records the frame's configured address. When currentPath differs, navigate the frame to that path after creation to restore the captured view while keeping its configured address.
Use the destination app's actual host and port instead of assuming localhost:1430. Preserve query strings.
Verify all restored frames with list_frames. Report their links. Repeating this restore creates additional pages unless the user requests reconciliation.
